## Writing code for run_code

A generated PTC SDK section, miniatured: the fixture exercises both interfaces,
nesting, unions, quoted literals with commas, an unknown-typed MCP tool and a
no-argument tool. Loaded by test/sdk-slim.test.mjs and test/unit.test.mjs.

```ts
type JsonValue = null | boolean | number | string

interface ToolArgsMap {
  /** Search the web with optional time filtering. */
  advanced_search: {
    /** The search query. */
    query?: string;
    engine?: "ddg" | "bing, searxng";
  } & Record<string, JsonValue>;
  /** Enter one cell exactly as if typed: a number, text, or a formula starting with = ("=AVERAGE(B2:B9)"). Dependent cells recalculate. */
  mcp__gridcraft__set_cell: {
    /** Cell, e.g. "B7" or "Sheet2!C3". */
    cell: string;
    input: string | number | boolean;
  } & Record<string, JsonValue>;
  /** Sort a range by one or more columns; keys accepts objects or bare column letters. */
  mcp__gridcraft__sort_range: unknown;
  /** Open a PDF and return its document id. */
  mcp__pdfcraft__doc_open: {
    path: string;
  };
  /** No parameters at all. */
  mcp__gridcraft__workbook_list: Record<string, never>;
  /** Tiny fixture tool for the self-heal path: one required string. */
  mcp__fake__thing: {
    /** A required string. */
    a: string;
  } & Record<string, JsonValue>;
}

interface ToolOutputMap {
  advanced_search: {
    provider?: string;
  };
  mcp__gridcraft__set_cell: {
    content: ({ type: string; text?: string })[];
    isError?: boolean;
  };
  mcp__gridcraft__sort_range: unknown;
  mcp__pdfcraft__doc_open: {
    kind: string;
  };
  mcp__gridcraft__workbook_list: {
    kind: string;
  };
  mcp__fake__thing: {
    kind: string;
  };
}

type ToolName = keyof ToolOutputMap
declare const tools: {
  [K in ToolName]: (args: ToolArgsMap[K]) => Promise<ToolOutputMap[K]>;
}
```
